question: How do I get licensed to run a child care centre or family day home?

nuggets.text: No person may operate a child development facility without a licence from the Mayor (OSSE).
nuggets.quote: (a) Except as otherwise provided in this subchapter, no person shall, either directly or indirectly, operate a child development facility in the District without first having obtained a license to do so.

nuggets.text: A change in ownership requires relicensure.
nuggets.quote: Any change in ownership of a licensee owned by a person or in the legal or beneficial ownership of a percentage of stock established by rule of a corporate licensee shall require relicensure.

nuggets.text: Hearings follow the contested-case procedure of § 2-509.
nuggets.quote: (B) Administrative procedures for hearings consistent with the requirements of § 2-509 , unless otherwise provided in this subchapter;
